title: Aliens tell him they created humans and humanity is not ready

tellings.quote: dimensions. Your only achievement in civilization is that we created you, the intelligent beings here.

plain: A man named Kiran Ilum Xenov says that in 1997 he was taken aboard a spacecraft, where the beings told him they had made humankind and that humanity is not yet ready to know them. He tells Michels he was there, and quotes them as saying: "Your only achievement in civilization is that we created you, the intelligent beings here."
